name: omp-usage
description: Live model-usage limits for every account `omp` is logged in to. Shows one row per limit with a bar, percentage and reset time, grouped by provider and account, and raises a bell notification once per limit and reset window when a limit reaches 90% or is exhausted.
author: tommy
highlights: One row per limit across every provider account, with accounts in shaded cards
Amber from 75% used, red from 90% or exhausted
Bell notification once per limit and reset window at 90% and when a limit is exhausted, even with no dashboard tab open
Cached snapshot refreshed every 5 minutes in the background; the page refreshes on open and re-reads every minute
A composer chip shows the busiest limit on hover and tints amber from 75%
useCases: Notice that a 5-hour or weekly quota is about to run out before an agent session stalls on it.
configuration: Requires the `omp` CLI on the machine running Kiro Crew; enable the app and open OMP Usage from the sidebar. No account or settings are needed.
